subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should onProgressNarratorLifecycle, isProgressDraftVisible, and progressPreambleEnabled remain permanent public GetReplyOptions plugin SDK fields for external channel plugins?
rationale: The runtime behavior is coherent, but repository policy makes additive plugin APIs compatibility-sensitive; only maintainers can choose whether these implementation-shaped lifecycle callbacks are the supported long-term extension contract.

options.title: Approve the additive SDK seam
options.body: Keep the three fields public, document their lifecycle and retraction semantics, and retain focused compatibility and extension-boundary coverage.

options.title: Internalize the lifecycle bridge
options.body: Move the callbacks behind an internal channel runtime helper so this fix does not permanently expand the external plugin SDK.

options.title: Pause the cross-channel rollout
options.body: Keep the current released progress behavior until a narrower shared lifecycle API is designed and reviewed.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the three fields public, document their lifecycle and retraction semantics, and retain focused compatibility and extension-boundary coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked product proposal, exact-head implementation, and current review coordination for this shared channel behavior.
